walkthroughs.body_html:
Food Safety, Food Science and Special Diets — a core area of GCSE Food Preparation and Nutrition.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Food Safety, Food Science and Special Diets brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Safety, Food Science and Special Diets.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which vitamin do vegans need to supplement?
options: A
C
E
Vegan
Gluten-free
Low fat
Kosher

mcqs.q: What are the 4 Cs of food hygiene?
options: Calories, Carbs, Calcium, Cholesterol.
Chopping, Cleaning, Cooling, Carrying.
Cleaning, Cooking, Chilling, and avoiding Cross-contamination.
Because they are illegal.

mcqs.q: On a traffic-light label, what does a red light indicate?
options: High amounts of that nutrient per 100g - eat less often.
The food is organic.
The food is dangerous and should never be eaten.
Because they are illegal.

mcqs.q: Why must the 14 major allergens be highlighted on UK food labels?
options: Because they are illegal.
The food is organic.
To advertise that the food contains them.
Reactions can be severe or life-threatening, so consumers must identify them at a glance.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Gluten-free”?
options: Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Jewish dietary rules from Torah; no pork, shellfish; meat and dairy kept apart.
Excludes meat and fish; lacto-ovo includes dairy and eggs.
Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Kosher”?
options: Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Jewish dietary rules from Torah; no pork, shellfish; meat and dairy kept apart.
Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.
Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Vegan”?
options: Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.
Excludes meat and fish; lacto-ovo includes dairy and eggs.
Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Vegetarian”?
options: Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.
Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.
Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Excludes meat and fish; lacto-ovo includes dairy and eggs.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Diabetic diet”?
options: Manages blood glucose; emphasises low-GI carbohydrates, portion control.
Excludes meat and fish; lacto-ovo includes dairy and eggs.
Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Halal”?
options: Manages blood glucose; emphasises low-GI carbohydrates, portion control.
Excludes wheat, barley, rye; essential for coeliac disease.
Excludes all animal products; needs vitamin B12 supplementation.
Islamic dietary rules; meat from animals slaughtered with prayer; no pork or alcohol.

mcqs.q: Number of major animal-product categories vegans avoid (meat, fish, dairy, eggs, honey: pick number)?
options: 4 categories
6 categories
5 categories
3 categories

mcqs.q: A person with lactose intolerance is most likely to get symptoms (bloating, stomach pain) after eating:
options: A bowl of custard made with cows' milk
Plain boiled rice
Grilled chicken breast
An apple

mcqs.q: Pregnant women are advised to avoid soft mould-ripened cheeses such as brie because of the risk of:
options: Listeria bacteria, which can harm the unborn baby
Too much vitamin C
The cheese containing gluten
Iron overdose

mcqs.q: Which lunch is most suitable for someone managing type 2 diabetes?
options: Wholegrain pitta with chicken and salad
Large white baguette with jam and a sugary cola
Three doughnuts and sweetened milkshake
Chocolate bar and an energy drink

mcqs.q: Which of these grains is naturally safe for a person with coeliac disease?
options: Rice
Wheat
Barley
Rye
